properties.name: camunda.document.assigned
properties.description: Selects which configured document store ids are active for a physical tenant. Must not be set at the root level; it is only relevant per physical tenant and must be set under 'camunda.physical-tenants.[tenant-id].document.assigned'.

properties.name: camunda.security.authentication.providers.assigned
properties.description: Selects which OIDC providers are active for a physical tenant. Must not be set at the root level; it is only relevant per physical tenant and must be set under 'camunda.physical-tenants.[tenant-id].security.authentication.providers.assigned'.

properties.name: camunda.data.exporters-assigned
properties.description: Manifest of the generic exporters active for a physical tenant. Must not list the autoconfigured 'camundaexporter' or 'rdbms' exporters — only custom exporters may be listed here. Must not be set at the root level; it is only relevant per physical tenant and must be set under 'camunda.physical-tenants.[tenant-id].data.exporters-assigned'.
